chapter_seo_title: The Hamlet (Ch. 202) – Li Huowang Faces Starvation in a Hidden Village
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang's group faces starvation. A desperate gamble leads them to a hidden mountain village. But in the Dao-Twisted World, not even paradise opens its door for the hungry.
og_title: The Hamlet – Starvation and a Hidden Door
og_description: No monsters, just a closed door. Li Huowang’s crew faces the cruelest horror yet: running out of food.
twitter_title: The Hamlet – Starving on a mountaintop
twitter_description: A quiet, grim chapter where the real enemy is an empty stomach. Li Huowang refuses to become his master, but the world refuses to feed him.
